skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
Apparel worn by Nearl during the Kazimierz Major. 
It is more practical than her uniform, and will not affect her performance at all.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
She once again took the championship, not to prove herself, but to affect change. 
Even after the Major ended, she still continues to wear it.

skins.name: Relight
skins.content: EPOQUE Sub-Brand [Passe] Series Selects/Relight. One of the many suits of armor worn by Nearl in her debut competition season, this one a modification of a campaign knight suit.
skins.usage: One of Nearl the Radiant Knight's casual outfits.
skins.quote: Nearl has been prepared, since the very outset of her competition participation, to serve as the lighthouse that shines through Kazimierz's night sky. The torrents of time have not sufficed to quench this flame, instead only allowing her to burn brighter.
